title: 第2章 电梯坠落预言应验！-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    【什么声音？？？】

    【不会吧不会吧不会吧？？？】

    靳兰玦垂眼看向手机屏幕，直播间的人数正在飞快上升。

    其中一条弹幕吸引了大家的注意力。

    【我操！电梯真的坠毁了！】

    【我就住安和小区A栋，看到直播专门过来守着】

    【真的坠毁了！】

    【我操！我操！】

    轰然巨响过后，外面像是沉寂了一阵，开始有嘈杂的人声响起。

    女人的尖叫声、孩子的哭声、男人的喊叫声搅和在一起，乱七八糟的撕开了安静的空气。

    弹幕中网友的证词，与直播间响起的外界环境音，都在证实靳兰玦的预言。

    何秀芳张着嘴，看向自己的丈夫。

    靳建国面色难看极了，手指一抖，烟头掉在地上。

    靳泽宇捂着满脸的血，忘记了惨叫，呆呆地看看自己爸妈，又将目光投向窗外。

    满室寂静中，有个男人的声音格外尖利，话音清晰透过窗户传进屋内所有人的耳中：

    “电梯掉下去了！”

    “快打120！救护车！叫救护车！”

    “那是什么东西？一个红的！”

    【咚——】

    脑海中响起天机系统机械的提示音。

    【电梯坠落预言应验！】

    【天机值+180，当前天机值：185。】

    【解锁能力：低级诡物感知。感知半径，500米范围内的一切诡物存在。】

    靳兰玦看向自己的手机界面，直播间的屏幕空白一片，弹幕安静了整整十几秒。

    接下来密密麻麻的弹幕飞快刷过。

    【我靠！真的假的？！】

    【在现场的那个不会是托吧？】

    【是真的！我是隔壁小区的，看到直播就赶过来守着了，你们不信可以来我主页看我的直播间！】

    【我操我操！那个电梯门在发红光啊！你们在现场的人看到了吗？】

    【大师对不起对不起！我不是故意要骂你的，您大人有大量不要跟我计较】

    明明已经凌晨两点多，但直播间内在线人数还在持续疯长。

    5000、1万、3万、10万……

    十分钟不到，直播间的在线人数突破了五十万！
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

【What is the sound???】

【No way, no way, no way???】

Jin Lanjue lowered his eyes and looked at the screen of his mobile phone. The number of people in the live broadcast room was rising rapidly.

​ One of the barrages attracted everyone’s attention.

【Oh my god!The elevator really crashed!】

【I live in Building A of Anhe Community, and when I saw the live broadcast, I came here to guard it】

【It really crashed!】

【Oh my god!Holy shit!】

After the loud noise, there seemed to be silence outside for a while, and noisy voices began to sound.

The screams of women, the cries of children, and the shouts of men mixed together, tearing apart the quiet air in a mess.

The testimonies of netizens in the barrage and the external ambient sounds in the live broadcast room all confirm Jin Lanjue's prediction.

He Xiufang opened her mouth and looked at her husband.

Jin Jianguo looked extremely ugly. With a flick of his finger, the cigarette butt fell to the ground.

Jin Zeyu covered his face with blood and forgot to scream. He looked at his parents blankly and then looked out the window.

In the silence of the room, a man's voice was particularly sharp, and the words were clearly heard through the window and reached the ears of everyone in the room:

"The elevator fell down!"

"Call 120 quickly! Ambulance! Call an ambulance!"

"What is that? A red one!"

【咚——】

The mechanical sound of the Tianji system sounded in my mind.

【The prophecy of the elevator falling has come true!】

【The secret value is +180, the current secret value is: 185.】

【Unlocked ability: Low-level monster perception.Sensing radius, all strange things within 500 meters exist.】

Jin Lanjue looked at his mobile phone interface. The screen in the live broadcast room was blank, and the barrage was silent for more than ten seconds.

​The next dense barrage quickly passed by.

【Damn it!Real or fake?!】

【Isn't the one at the scene a trustee?】

【It's true!I live in the community next door. When I saw the live broadcast, I rushed over to guard it. If you don’t believe it, you can come to my homepage to watch my live broadcast room!】

【Fuck me, fuck me!That elevator door is glowing red!Did you people at the scene see it?】

【Master, I'm sorry!I didn’t mean to scold you. You, sir, have a lot of money, so don’t argue with me]

It’s already past two o’clock in the morning, but the number of people online in the live broadcast room continues to grow exponentially.

5000, 10,000, 30,000, 100,000...

In less than ten minutes, the number of people online in the live broadcast room exceeded 500,000!
